row: Hidden Pond Farm Equine Rescue is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organization located in Brentwood, NH. Our mission to save horses in danger of entering the slaughter pipeline, either by buying horses at auction, bailing them out from kill pens, or by assisting owners who can no longer take care of them. We rescue, rehab, and rehome them to safe, loving, forever homes. Learn more at https://hiddenpondequinerescue.org
